title: LEV: Thinking Fast and Deep with Looped Decision Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.20951v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Decision models answer typed questions about an input with one probability per option, computed in a single forward pass without generating text. Like the fast System 1 of dual-process theory, they answer at once, but their depth is fixed at training time, so they spend the same computation on easy and hard questions. Models that reason in generated text can think longer, but they pay for every extra step in decoded tokens. We present LEV, a decision model that thinks deeper by rerunning its layers in a loop instead of generating tokens. LEV builds on a language model pretrained as a loop, reads the options after every loop step and trains all steps jointly, so one checkpoint can answer at any depth. On three looped backbones, accuracy rises with depth on the same weights, mostly on hard questions, and a 2.6B LEV goes from 63.2% at depth one to 76.2% at depth four on JevBench. translated_title: LEV：基于循环决策模型的快速且深度思考
translated_abstract: 决策模型通过对输入的提问为每个选项输出一个概率来作答，在单次前向传播中完成计算，无需生成文本。就像双过程理论中快速的“系统1”，它们能够立即作答，但其深度在训练时即已固定，因此在简单问题和困难问题上花费相同的计算量。通过生成文本进行推理的模型可以思考更久，但每多推一步都需要付出解码token的代价。我们提出了LEV，一种通过循环重复运行其层级而非生成token来实现更深思考的决策模型。LEV构建于以循环方式预训练的语言模型之上，在每次循环步骤后读取选项并联合训练所有步骤，因此单个模型检查点可以在任意深度进行作答。在三个循环骨干模型上，同一权重的准确率随深度增加而提升，且提升主要体现在困难问题上：一个2.6B参数的LEV在JevBench上的准确率从深度一时的63.2%提升至深度四时的76.2%。按需分配的深度由一个小型停止器针对每个问题进行设置……
tldr: LEV是一种循环决策模型，通过反复运行模型层级而非生成token来实现按需可变的思考深度，单个模型即可在任意深度作答，且准确率随深度提升，尤其在困难问题上收益显著。
en_tdlr: LEV is a decision model that thinks deeper by looping its layers instead of generating tokens, enabling a single checkpoint to answer at any depth, with accuracy consistently improving with depth, especially on hard questions.
